record.question: P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are friends. They are sitting around a round table. P is sitting between U and V, Q is sitting between W and T, R is sitting to the third left of T and, W is sitting to the third right of S. How many persons are sitting between R and S?
record.explanation: Solving the circular seating constraints: P between U,V; Q between W,T; R third left of T; W third right of S. The only consistent arrangements place R and S opposite each other (4 steps apart), with 3 persons between them on either arc.
